mdf.step1Note: You need to keep defending with the top {{pct}}% of your range to prevent opponents from profiting with bluffs
mdf.step2Title: Step 2: Calculate Required Equity to Call
mdf.step2Warning: Note: This is different from MDF! Don't confuse them.
mdf.step2Note: This is the minimum equity you need to call. If your actual equity is higher, calling is profitable
mdf.scenarioMdf: When facing a bet, how often you must continue (call/raise) as the defender to prevent the opponent from bluffing infinitely
mdf.wrongMdf: Don't confuse with Required Equity — MDF answers 'how often to call', not 'whether this hand calls'
mdf.scenarioReqEquity: Break-even point of a single call decision, used to judge whether calling a hand is profitable
mdf.wrongReqEquity: Denominator is pot+2bet, not pot+bet — note the difference from MDF's denominator
mdf.scenarioBluff: How much of your betting range should be bluffs so opponents can't profitably adjust
mdf.wrongBluff: Same formula as Required Equity, but the direction of application is exactly opposite (offense vs defense)
